description: REQ-009 requires all four organ row sets to come through one RPC, but its acceptance criterion still requires every score query to contain four direct PostgREST-style uid, organ, inclusive-start, and exclusive-end filters. A sole RPC request carries p_uid and p_periods rather than uid=eq/organ=eq URL filters, so the endpoint and its tests cannot satisfy both contracts without deciding whether the filter assertions apply to the HTTP request or to SQL inside the RPC.

evidence.snippet: obtain all four organ row sets through one read-only database RPC transaction ... Integration tests inspect every score query for uid=eq.<session uid>, organ=eq.<organ>, inclusive start, and exclusive end.
